answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Business Question ID: 4826 Country: India Title: I am involved in share trading. i am purchasing & selling shares(intraday). sometimes i am doing short sell (before purchasing shares, forward sell). i do get shares delivery. can i do short sell? (sell first & purchase after). i hope soon from you. Question: I am involved in share trading. i am purchasing & selling shares(intraday). sometimes i am doing short sell (before purchasing shares, forward sell). i do get shares delivery. can i do short sell? (sell first & purchase after). i hope soon from you. zazakallah Answer ID: 4826 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 938/873=D/1429) It is unlawful to sell a thing which you do not own or which you do not have in your possession. Therefore, the above-mentioned short selling is unlawful. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
